hero.title: PGP College of Agricultural Sciences
hero.summary: PGPCAS offers agriculture education in Namakkal through TNAU-affiliated degree and diploma study. Its college site describes a farmland setting near the Kolli Hills and field training at the group’s Paramathi campus. The audited ICAR entry covers the undergraduate agriculture degree.

overview.heading: Agriculture study with a Namakkal field setting
paragraphs: PGP College of Agricultural Sciences was established in 2013 and is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University. Its dedicated college website describes a campus near the Kolli Hills and additional field training at the group’s main campus in Paramathi.

The agriculture degree is taught over eight semesters and combines crop science with agricultural economics and practical subjects. Its published curriculum gives examples of seed treatment, sowing, nursery techniques and crop diagnosis. Applicants can explore how those practical elements develop through the programme while comparing the university counselling and management admission channels described by the college.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The four-year, eight-semester curriculum covers agronomy, plant protection, soil science and agricultural economics. Published practical examples include sowing, seed treatment, nursery work, crop diagnosis and farm machinery.
programmes.eligibility: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.
programmes.admission_route: The 2026–27 admission page describes TNAU single-window counselling and management admission, with TNAU online registration mandatory for both.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at PGP College of Agricultural Sciences, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu for 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to PGPCAS
admissions.intro: PGPCAS publishes a 65% TNAU single-window and 35% management split. Its 2026–27 page says applicants seeking management seats must first register with TNAU, then contact the college. These instructions need confirmation for a later cycle.

steps.title: Complete TNAU registration
steps.text: The college states that online submission to TNAU is mandatory for counselling and management channels.

steps.title: Follow the relevant channel
steps.text: For counselling, allocation follows rank and preferences. For management admission, the page asks registered applicants to contact the college directly.

dates.label: Published B.Sc. Agriculture application end date

campus.heading: Practical subjects across the agriculture curriculum
campus.intro: The programme outline gives concrete examples of practical teaching: seed and sowing exercises, horticultural propagation, surveying and irrigation work. These are published curriculum components, not confirmation that every listed visit occurs for every cohort.

facilities.name: Agricultural field setting
facilities.description: The college describes farmland around its Namakkal campus and additional training land at Paramathi.

facilities.name: Separate student hostels
facilities.description: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

practical_learning: The curriculum lists seed treatment, tillage and sowing exercises.
Later-semester descriptions include specimen identification, seed-processing practice and machinery demonstrations.

student_services.name: Separate student hostels
student_services.description: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The home page describes scholarships and awards and gives a group-wide annual award statement. It does not provide dated agriculture-specific award terms; no amount is represented here as an individual entitlement.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The official programme page lists possible agricultural, research and rural-development careers. The home page links a placement cell, but neither fact establishes a measured agriculture employment rate. Request a recent cohort report before comparing outcomes.

faqs.question: When did PGPCAS start?
faqs.answer: The official college home page states 2013.

faqs.question: How long is its agriculture degree?
faqs.answer: The college specifies four years and eight semesters, with English as the medium of instruction.

faqs.question: Is TNAU registration needed for management admission?
faqs.answer: The college’s 2026–27 page says it is compulsory for management applicants as well as counselling applicants.

faqs.question: Are the listed June 2026 dates current deadlines?
faqs.answer: They are published dates for the 2026–27 cycle. Because the check occurred in October, they should be read as historical rather than an invitation to apply.

faqs.question: Is the diploma also covered by the audited ICAR row?
faqs.answer: The college offers a diploma, but the audited row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Diploma accreditation is not inferred.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.

faqs.question: What residential or welfare facilities does PGPCAS describe?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS lists faculty by department and identifies heads for several subject groups. Selected teaching entries below cover management, improvement, protection, horticulture and social science. Dr. M. Srinivasan — Associate Professor, Agricultural Microbiology; Dr. D. Ravisankar — Associate Professor, Agronomy; Dr. S. Vinithra — Assistant Professor, Plant Breeding and Genetics; Head, Crop Improvement.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: https://pgpagricollege.ac.in/admission/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.
